context_strategy: E-Commerce & Digital Storefront / Organic Earthy Editorial Luxury

surface_strategies.card_style: Flat with crisp 1px subtle borders, generous internal padding p-8, no heavy shadows except subtle lift on hover.

layout_rules.bento_grids: Asymmetric grids with wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12), generous spacing (p-12 to p-20), clear visual hierarchy.

custom_storefront_sections: Product Grid with Quick View & Instant Purchase
Product Detail Drawer/Modal with File Preview & Copy Editor
Owner Admin Portal (Product creation, File upload, Branding editor, Order fulfillment dashboard)
Secure Post-Payment Claimable Download Modal / Order Record

accessibility.apca_contrast: WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a stunning, responsive Digital Product Storefront ('An app that will make money while i sleep') with automated digital delivery, one-time checkout (Stripe claimable setup), owner product management, private file storage simulation, order dashboard, category filtering, and editable branding and product copy. Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes. Use Tailwind CSS and Shadcn primitives. Strictly adhere to design guidelines, gorgeous editorial typography, generous spacing, and smooth Framer Motion animations.
